description: Inventaire des cavités souterraines (GPX) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DELETED DELETED. Inventory of underground cavities (BRGM BDCavity), in GPX format. Conversion of CSV data to GPX. The data was retrieved with this script:. Coverage: DELETED DELETED. The portal shows the English title as "Underground Cavity Inventory (GPX)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DELETED DELETED. Its keywords include brgm, cavites-souterraines, cavite, bdcavite, speleo, cavites. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2022-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
